contract.title: Authoritative Asset Business Context & Business-Impact Readiness
acceptance_criteria: Execution changes only the exact twenty allowed paths and Scope Guard reports COMPLIANT; no implicit or wildcard scope expansion is permitted.

AssetContext remains byte-unchanged and authoritative only for observed identifier canonical asset identity asset criticality and source reference; AssetCriticality is never substituted for ServiceCriticality or Business Impact.

The new immutable AssetBusinessContext contains exactly canonical_asset_id business_service BusinessEnvironment ServiceCriticality and source_reference with non-empty normalized values and runtime enum validation.
BusinessEnvironment is a new finite enum containing exactly PRODUCTION PRE_PRODUCTION DEVELOPMENT and TEST because no existing authoritative equivalent exists.
ServiceCriticality is a new finite enum containing exactly CRITICAL HIGH MEDIUM and LOW and is deliberately distinct from technical severity and AssetCriticality.

The strict JSON authority accepts only root assetBusinessContexts and exact record keys canonicalAssetId businessService environment serviceCriticality and sourceReference; malformed unknown missing empty or invalid values fail controlled.

An unconfigured optional ASSET_BUSINESS_CONTEXT_PATH or an absent canonical record resolves as no context without defaults; a configured unreadable or invalid source fails controlled and is not treated as empty.
Duplicate equal or conflicting records for one canonical asset fail as ambiguity/integrity errors and are never merged selected or silently resolved.

Finding business-context resolution consumes the existing FindingAssetContextResolution snapshot without rereading Findings or AssetContext and returns exactly RESOLVED NOT_FOUND or MISSING_CANONICAL_ASSET.

BusinessImpactReadiness returns only READY or UNAVAILABLE and preserves finding identity ordered missing requirements authoritative facts referenced sources completeness and provenance with immutable state invariants.
READY requires canonical asset relationship business_service environment service_criticality and business_context_provenance; every missing fact yields UNAVAILABLE with exact truthful requirements.
Readiness performs no Business Impact calculation or classification and emits no impact score band narrative loss consequence crown-jewel owner decision recommendation or management conclusion.

FindingRiskContext integrates business_context and business_impact_readiness into its existing projection while preserving the same AssetContext snapshot and all TASK-0127 and TASK-0128 risk evidence and priority semantics.
FindingRiskContext business_impact remains null decision remains null and recommendations remain empty in every business-context and readiness state.
The API exposes typed business-context fields fact-level source references and readiness reason missing requirements completeness and provenance; unresolved payloads contain no placeholder facts.

The frontend parser rejects partial contradictory invalid-enum or provenance-free business-context/readiness payloads and the existing Finding Risk Context section renders only authoritative facts or explicit unavailable states.

Without an explicit Product-Owner-approved record the DistCC canonical asset renders Business Context NOT_FOUND Business Impact Readiness UNAVAILABLE and Business Impact null; no DistCC-specific context is added to code or tests.
No legacy BusinessContextEngine BusinessImpactBuilder Decision Risk Recommendation PriorityEngine AI/provider mock Risk Manager or Executive authority is invoked modified or populated.

Focused domain adapter resolution readiness integration API parser and rendering tests cover valid records missing configuration absent records malformed sources duplicates conflicts provenance state invariants and negative non-invocation guarantees.

Existing AssetContext Finding Risk Context Threat Intelligence correlation evidence readiness priority Explainability routing and workspace regressions plus full Python frontend TypeScript production build and git diff --check pass.
Product Owner live acceptance verifies a controlled authorized context record and the real DistCC fail-closed path; no DONE transition or TASK-0130 creation is authorized during execution.
